title: The Last Signal
preview: The transmission came through on a dead frequency. No one was supposed to be listening...
full:
The transmission came through on a dead frequency. No one was supposed to be listening — that was the point. Aeryn had built her scanner specifically to catch the gaps between channels, the silence that wasn't silence at all.

She almost missed it. The signal lasted 0.3 seconds and contained a single word in a language that had been classified as extinct for sixty years.

The word was: *run*.

She ran.

title: TIGIDB — Chapter Fragment
preview: There's an index at the end of the world. A database of everything that was supposed to matter...
full:
There's an index at the end of the world. A database of everything that was supposed to matter — every choice point, every fracture in the timeline. They call it TIGIDB. The Instances Got In Database.

Nobody remembers who named it. That's how you know it's been there a long time.
